title: What Actually Happens When You Catch a Cold
audience: General adult viewers with no medical background.
brief: Explain what happens in the body during a common cold and what actually helps. Goal: viewers download the free symptom diary linked in the description.

issues.description: States that around 80 percent of body heat escapes through the head. This is a myth; the head loses roughly in proportion to its surface area, about 10 percent.
Claims 'studies show' huge doses of vitamin C cut every cold in half, with no source. Evidence shows at most a small effect on duration, mainly in specific groups.
Tells viewers not to consult a doctor for a child's days-long high fever and to give a double dose of paracetamol repeatedly, which is dangerous medical advice.
The definition of antibodies is restated four times in slightly different words, slowing the video without adding information.
A sentence of immunology terminology (CD8-positive cytotoxic T lymphocytes, clonal expansion, MHC class one, interferon-gamma, macrophage activation) is delivered unexplained to a lay audience.
